content: Padilla Habano is a premium, hand-crafted cigar brand owned by the Padilla Cigar Company. The brand was introduced in 2005 by Ernesto Padilla and is manufactured at Tabacalera Oliva S.A. (Tabolisa) in Estelí, Nicaragua, under the supervision of Gilberto Oliva. The Robusto cigar from this brand received a rating of 89 in the October 2006 issue of Cigar Aficionado magazine. Additionally, the ratings for Padilla cigars were summarized in Cigar Insider magazine, with the Churchill scoring 90, the Robusto scoring 89, and the Torpedo scoring 88. These cigars are of medium strength. The wrapper is made from Cuban Habano leaf that has been aged for five years, while the binder and filler consist of Nicaraguan tobaccos. The cigars are packaged in varnished boxes, with 20 cigars per box. The band, artwork, and packaging were redesigned in 2006 by Ernesto Padilla.
